```{r}
#Input parameters - fixed

n<- 100 #population size
ct.rates<-10 #avg number of daily contacts per day
nSeeds<-20 #number of cases starting the epidemic
R0<-3 # average number of secondary cases generated per infected individual in a fully susceptible population
inf.param<- 10
#pathogen<-"COVID-19" # or "FLU"
t.stop  <- 360 # maximum number of days the simulation is running (if infected cases present)


#Compute the reproduction number related to the selected network. 
source("F:\\Statistics UHasselt\\Semester 4\\Master Thesis\\Master-Thesis---Chau-\\SEIR.R")
nSim<-100
nSeed<-22032026
set.seed(nSeed)

baseline_results <- list() 
group_results <- list() 
network_results <- list()

for (i in 1:nSim) {
  print(i)
  
  #SCENARIO 1: Free mixing (baseline)
  baseline_results[[i]] <- sim.epi_seir(
    n = n, ct.rates = ct.rates, nSeeds = 1, inf.param = inf.param, t.stop = t.stop)
  
  # SCENARIO 2: Group-based structured mixing
  groups <- c(rep(1, n/2), rep(2, n/2))
  M_matrix <- matrix(c(0.9, 0.1, 0.1, 0.9), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  group_results[[i]] <- sim.epi_seir(
    n = n, ct.rates = ct.rates, nSeeds = 1, inf.param = inf.param, t.stop = t.stop, group_assign = groups, M = M_matrix)

  # SCENARIO 3: Network-based mixing
  network_er <- function(n, p) {
  A <- matrix(rbinom(n*n, 1, p), nrow=n)
  diag(A) <- 0
  A[lower.tri(A)] <- t(A)[lower.tri(A)] # Làm cho ma trận đối xứng
  return(A)
  }
  A_network <- network_er(n = n, p = 0.15)
  network_results[[i]] <- sim.epi_seir(
    n = n, ct.rates = ct.rates, nSeeds  =1, inf.param = inf.param, t.stop = t.stop, A = A_network)
}

```



```{r}
analyze_results_seir <- function(results_list, n, t.stop) {
  
  # 1. Total Attack Rate
  # Count everyone who is NOT Susceptible (0), meaning they were E, I, or R
  attack_rates <- sapply(results_list, function(res) {
    sum(res$status.matrix$infected != 0) / n
  })
  
  # 2. Daily Infection Incidence
  # We track Event 0.5 (Exposed) because that is the moment of new infection
  inc_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(results_list), ncol = t.stop + 1)
  
  for (i in 1:length(results_list)) {
    # Extract times where event == 0.5
    inf_times <- results_list[[i]]$time.events[results_list[[i]]$time.events[,2] == 0.5, 1]
    if (length(inf_times) > 0) {
      tab <- table(factor(floor(inf_times), levels = 0:t.stop))
      inc_matrix[i, ] <- as.numeric(tab)
    }
  }
  
  avg_daily_inc <- colMeans(inc_matrix)
  
  # 3. Outbreak Probability
  # Probability that more than 10% of the population gets infected
  outbreak_prob <- mean(attack_rates > 0.10)
  
  return(list(
    attack_raw = attack_rates,
    mean_attack = mean(attack_rates),
    daily_inc = avg_daily_inc,
    outbreak_prob = outbreak_prob
  ))
}

#Print Total Attack Rate và Outbreak Outcome
summary_baseline <- analyze_results_seir(baseline_results, n, t.stop)
summary_group    <- analyze_results_seir(group_results, n, t.stop)
summary_network  <- analyze_results_seir(network_results, n, t.stop)

comparison_table <- data.frame(
  Scenario = c("Free Mixing", "Two Groups", "ER Network"),
  Avg_Attack_Rate = c(summary_baseline$mean_attack, summary_group$mean_attack, summary_network$mean_attack),
  Outbreak_Probability = c(summary_baseline$outbreak_prob, summary_group$outbreak_prob, summary_network$outbreak_prob)
)

print(comparison_table)
```



```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

get_cum_30_days_seir <- function(results_list, n, scenario_name) {
  t_limit <- 30
  cum_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(results_list), ncol = t_limit + 1)
  
  for (i in 1:length(results_list)) {
    # Track the 0.5 event (S -> E)
    inf_times <- results_list[[i]]$time.events[results_list[[i]]$time.events[,2] == 0.5, 1]
    
    if (length(inf_times) > 0) {
      daily_counts <- table(factor(floor(inf_times), levels = 0:t_limit))
      # Calculate cumulative proportion
      cum_matrix[i, ] <- cumsum(as.numeric(daily_counts)) / n
    }
  }
  
  return(data.frame(
    Day = 0:t_limit,
    Cumulative_Rate = colMeans(cum_matrix),
    Scenario = scenario_name
  ))
}


# Trích xuất dữ liệu cho 3 nhóm
df1 <- get_cum_30_days_seir(baseline_results, n, "Free Mixing")
df2 <- get_cum_30_days_seir(group_results, n, "Staff-Bridge Groups")
df3 <- get_cum_30_days_seir(network_results, n, "ER Network")

plot_data_30 <- rbind(df1, df2, df3)

# Vẽ biểu đồ
ggplot(plot_data_30, aes(x = Day, y = Cumulative_Rate, color = Scenario)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + # Thêm điểm để dễ nhìn từng ngày
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Early Phase: Cumulative Attack Rate (First 30 Days)",
    subtitle = "Comparison of population structures in Vaccinopolis model",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Cumulative Proportion Infected",
    color = "Model Scenario"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

```


```{r}
calculate_metrics_seir <- function(results_list, n) {
  # 1. Cumulative cases
  cum_cases_vec <- sapply(results_list, function(res) sum(res$status.matrix$infected != 0))
  
  # 2. Daily generated cases (Tránh lỗi NaN)
  daily_gen_vec <- sapply(results_list, function(res) {
    # Đếm sự kiện 0.5 (Exposed)
    inf_events <- sum(res$time.events[,2] == 0.5)
    max_t <- max(res$time.events[,1])
    if (length(max_t) > 0 && max_t > 0) {
      return(inf_events / max_t)
    } else {
      return(0)
    }
  })
  
  # 3. Transmission ratio
  trans_ratio_vec <- sapply(results_list, function(res) {
    total_inf <- sum(res$status.matrix$infected != 0)
    seeds <- sum(res$status.matrix$time.of.infection == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (total_inf > seeds) return((total_inf - seeds) / total_inf) else return(0)
  })
  
  return(c(
    Avg_Daily_Cases = round(mean(daily_gen_vec), 2),
    Cumulative_Cases = round(mean(cum_cases_vec), 0),
    Cumulative_Perc = paste0(round((mean(cum_cases_vec)/n)*100, 1), "%"),
    Transmission_Ratio = round(mean(trans_ratio_vec), 2)
  ))
}

# Tính toán cho từng Scenario
scn1_metrics <- calculate_metrics_seir(baseline_results, n, nSim)
scn2_metrics <- calculate_metrics_seir(group_results, n, nSim)
scn3_metrics <- calculate_metrics_seir(network_results, n, nSim)

# Tạo bảng tổng hợp (Transpose để giống mẫu của bạn)
summary_table_final <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Average daily generated cases", "Cumulative cases", 
             "Cumulative cases percentage", "Transmission ratio"),
  Scn.1 = scn1_metrics,
  Scn.2 = scn2_metrics,
  Scn.3 = scn3_metrics,
  row.names = NULL
)

# Tính % thay đổi so với Scn.1 cho chỉ số Daily Cases (giống trong ngoặc đơn mẫu)
calc_change <- function(val, ref) {
  change <- ((as.numeric(val) - as.numeric(ref)) / as.numeric(ref)) * 100
  return(paste0(val, " (", round(change, 0), "%)"))
}

summary_table_final[1, "Scn.2"] <- calc_change(scn2_metrics[1], scn1_metrics[1])
summary_table_final[1, "Scn.3"] <- calc_change(scn3_metrics[1], scn1_metrics[1])

# Hiển thị bảng
print(summary_table_final)
```
